goal: Keep current source consent and checked Claim availability authoritative after the last phase or source-grant callback, before held private context can return.
procedure: Assemble a real governed-state context using actual selected XTDB source registration and owner-authorized purpose grants over controlled SQL/canonical ports. Use a stable phase callback counter, without function-frame inspection, to make the last current-action callback withdraw an earlier source grant while returning its own valid grant. Repeat with explicit selected current-Claim custody rows quarantined by the last source callback. Confirm both new regression assertions fail against the published pre-repair context guard because it returns normally. Add one call-local selected metadata sampler for exact captured sources, raw references, immutable permission actions, current heads and current Claim records. Keep selected decoder and policy callbacks, preserve custom reader callbacks, and finish with one actual terminal all-row selected query after all final phase/current-action callbacks. Compare original controller, source predicate and canonical reader identities before and after the terminal query. Reuse only same-guard row observations; never retain an allow answer, owner approval or semantic verdict.
authority: Owner-authorized selected source grants, current Claim availability, exact canonical evidence, live owner proofs and supplied producer qualification remain separate authorities. Supplied state and explicit Claim rows are mechanics fixtures and establish no learned behavior.
validation: Both last-callback race regressions fail against the published old context guard with PermissionError not raised. Repaired current-context suite passes 29 tests, including source withdrawal, Claim quarantine, phase/policy/canonical-reader rebinding and finite selected query-count gates. Affected native reader and judgment-lineage suites pass 29 tests in 64.869 seconds. Actual selected-engine execution and consumer latency remain unqualified for this new checkpoint.
failure_or_lesson: Sequentially fresh grant checks can accept an earlier source after a later callback revokes it; an earlier current Claim check can likewise miss a later quarantine. A terminal query must observe the complete sampled source/grant/current-Claim set together after the last callback.
